title: Vibrating Wire Piezometer — Pore Pressure
applicability: Digits = f² × 10⁻³ (some manufacturers use f² directly). CF and CT from calibration certificate. Thermal correction often small relative to pressure change for buried piezometers.
source: Manufacturer calibration protocol — Geokon, RST, Slope Indicator

title: Standpipe Piezometer Response Time

t₉₅.description: Time to achieve 95% of equilibrium response

F.description: Time lag factor (depends on geometry; typically 10–50)

F_intake.description: Intake factor (shape factor of porous element)

applicability: For Casagrande-type piezometer with porous stone: F_intake ≈ 2.75D for L/D ≈ 5 (Hvorslev). In k = 10⁻⁹ m/s clay with 19 mm standpipe: t₉₅ can be weeks to months. VW piezometers have near-zero volume change → much faster response.

title: Inclinometer Lateral Displacement

δ_i.description: Cumulative lateral displacement at depth i, relative to bottom of casing

θ_j.description: Tilt angle at depth j from vertical

applicability: Summation proceeds from the bottom anchor (assumed fixed) upward. Change in displacement = current profile minus initial (baseline) profile. Accuracy: ±2 mm per 25 m of casing for manual traverse. A+A' (0° and 180°) checksums should cancel — deviation indicates probe error.

title: Settlement from Hydraulic Settlement Gauge

S.description: Settlement of embedded plate relative to readout elevation

applicability: Operating principle: liquid manometer. Settlement of the plate raises the liquid column, increasing pressure at the readout. Temperature affects liquid density — correct if large temperature changes occur.

title: Vibrating Wire Strain Gauge — Microstrain

CT_strain.description: Thermal coefficient of strain gauge (accounts for differential thermal expansion)

applicability: Stress = E × (με × 10⁻⁶). For concrete: E = 25–35 GPa. For steel: E = 200 GPa. Thermal correction is critical — steel gauge in concrete experiences apparent strain from differential thermal expansion (α_steel ≠ α_concrete).

title: MPBX — Relative Displacement Between Anchors

Δ_ij.description: Relative displacement between anchors i and j

L_i, L_j.description: Current rod/wire lengths to anchors i and j

applicability: Measures convergence or extension between anchor points. For tunnel monitoring: convergence = closure of the opening. Reference head movement must be accounted for — survey the head independently.

title: Total Pressure Cell — Effective Stress Check

σ_total.description: Total stress from earth pressure cell

u.description: Pore water pressure from adjacent piezometer

applicability: Earth pressure cells measure total stress. Co-locate with piezometers to compute effective stress. Compare with theoretical overburden: σ_v = γ × z. Deviation indicates arching, stress concentration, or instrument error.

title: Survey Monument — 3D Displacement from Coordinates
applicability: Vector components provide direction of movement. Vertical (settlement) = z₁-z₀. Horizontal = √[(x₁-x₀)²+(y₁-y₀)²]. Plot time-displacement to identify trends, acceleration. Precision: ±1 mm (precise leveling), ±2–3 mm (total station), ±5–10 mm (RTK GPS).
